body_diode.limitations: Generic silicon junction with Shockley forward/reverse leakage and finite series resistance; no reverse breakdown, capacitance, charge storage, thermal dynamics, ratings or physical part identity.

model.limitations: Generic enhancement PMOS with square-law channel, channel-length modulation and drain-to-source body diode. Body tied to source; zero gate current. No subthreshold conduction, body effect, gate/junction capacitance, charge storage, switching loss, breakdown, heating, ratings or named device identity. External capacitors provide circuit timing. Same illustrative beta magnitude as the generic NMOS, not a physical matched pair.
